candidate_relations.reason: The histopathology explicitly shows a hypovascular myxoid lesion with spindle and stellate cells, no epithelial components, no mitoses, S100 positive, CD34 negative — all consistent with myxoma. Medulloepithelioma would show epithelial/neuroepithelial components, teratoid elements, and different IHC profile. Both involve the ciliary body but they are incompatible histological entities.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Medulloepithelioma is a distinct ciliary body neoplasm with epithelial components and different histology; the reference is ciliary body myxoma

case_quality_flags: Classic ciliary body myxoma presentation with confirmatory IHC (S100+, GFAP patchy+, CD34-, SMA-) and myxoid stroma on histology; reference diagnosis well-supported by clinical record
